releaseNotes: Added route-condition reporting for vehicles on the shoulder and roadway obstructions, including the requested vehicle and obstruction details.
Moved the report control into the navigation button stack and enabled reporting while off route for testing.
Rechecked all 50 state profiles for pilot and escort vehicle requirements and removed truck-only requirements from the escort guidance.
Added a clear bumper-mount or roof-mount sign status above each state's escort trigger requirements.
